summary: Iteration 2 focused on new features only: Resend email notification, contact inbox read/unread + mark-as-read, 35 bulk-imported certifications with PDF thumbnails, and per-route SEO page titles. All 23 backend pytest tests pass (100%). All frontend flows pass (100%). Backend log confirms 'Contact notification email sent: <resend_id>' every submission. Certifications page shows 35 cards with 34 thumbnail imgs (31 PDF thumbs + 3 image certs; 1 cert without file - as expected). Category tab counts match spec exactly (Anthropic 12, IBM 4, Cisco 3, Google 7, University of Helsinki 1, Amazon 1, Simplilearn 7). Contact form -> Inbox flow: New badge shown, unread count '1 unread', mark-as-read clears badge and drops unread to 0, delete removes message. document.title updates on route change (/skills, /summary, /contact, /certifications all match PAGE_TITLES map).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py send_contact_email swallows all exceptions and only logs - fine since email is async fire-and-forget, but consider a retry queue for production.
PATCH /contact/messages/{id}/read is idempotent (no-op if already read) - good.
PDF thumbnail generation via pdftoppm is synchronous inside the request path - on very large PDFs this could block; not a blocker for current small cert PDFs but worth noting.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Created + deleted 1 test PDF cert via API and 1 test contact message via UI+API - all cleaned up.
